user.title: Connect to Gitea
user.description: Gitea (or Forgejo) issues become to-do lists. Use a personal access token with the **read:user**, **read:repository** and **read:issue** scopes (add **write:issue** if you want to close issues from Home Assistant).

data_description.url: Address of your Gitea instance, e.g. {example_url}.
data_description.api_token: Create one under **Settings → Applications → Access tokens** in Gitea.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for self-signed certificates.

reauth_confirm.title: Gitea token expired
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {url} no longer works. Enter a new token for the same Gitea user.

data_description.api_token: Create one under **Settings → Applications → Access tokens** in Gitea.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Gitea
reconfigure.description: Change the address, token or certificate check. The token must belong to the same Gitea user.

data_description.url: Address of your Gitea instance, e.g. {example_url}.
data_description.api_token: Create one under **Settings → Applications → Access tokens** in Gitea.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for self-signed certificates.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't connect to Gitea. Check the URL and that Home Assistant can reach it.
error.invalid_url: This doesn't look like a Gitea instance. Use the address you open in a browser, without a repository path.
error.missing_scope: The token works but lacks the **read:user** scope.

abort.already_configured: This Gitea user is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different Gitea user. Add that user as a new entry instead.

user.title: Add a repository
user.description: Its open issues become a to-do list.

labels.title: Filter by label
labels.description: Choose which issues of {repository} to show. Leave both empty to show all of them.

data_description.include_labels: An issue is shown if it has any of these labels.
data_description.exclude_labels: An issue with any of these labels is hidden, even if it has an included label.

reconfigure.title: Filter {repository} by label
reconfigure.description: Choose which issues of {repository} to show. Leave both empty to show all of them.

data_description.include_labels: An issue is shown if it has any of these labels.
data_description.exclude_labels: An issue with any of these labels is hidden, even if it has an included label.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't connect to Gitea. Check the URL and that Home Assistant can reach it.
error.issues_disabled: This repository has its issue tracker turned off.
error.repository_not_found: Repository not found, or the token's user can't see it.

abort.already_configured: This repository is already on a list.
abort.entry_not_loaded: The Gitea connection isn't loaded. Fix it first, then add repositories.

data.allow_closing: Allow closing issues from Home Assistant

data_description.scan_interval: How often each repository is checked, in minutes.
data_description.completed_days: Closed issues stay on the list as completed items for this many days. 0 hides them.
data_description.allow_closing: Ticking an item off closes the issue in Gitea; unticking reopens it. Needs a token with the **write:issue** scope. Nothing else can be changed from Home Assistant.

invalid_auth.message: The Gitea access token was rejected.

no_write_permission.message: Gitea refused to change the issue in {repository}. The token needs the write:issue scope and its user write access to the repository's issues.

only_status.message: Only the status can be changed. Edit the issue in Gitea to change anything else.

repository_not_found.title: Gitea repository {repository} not found
repository_not_found.description:
The repository {repository} (in {entry}) was deleted, or the token's user can no longer see it. Its to-do list is unavailable.

If it's gone for good, remove the repository from the Gitea To-do entry. If access was taken away, give the user access again; this message goes away at the next update.
